name: FUN_CATALOG_OBJECT_USAGES_
description: This table contains the usage of a business object for a consumer or consumption use case. Each consumer is of a consumer type such as outbound consumer, sensors, and segmentation.

columns.name: USAGE_ID
columns.description: Identifies catalog object usages

columns.name: CONSUMER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifies corresponding source data object.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Object type code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_CTLG_OBJECT_TYPES.

columns.name: CONSUMER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Consumer type code. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_CTLG_CONSUMER_TYPES.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_LIST
columns.description: List of extract attributes stored in a character large object value.

columns.name: SORT_BY
columns.description: Sorting criteria for the object usage.

columns.name: FILTER_CONDITION
columns.description: Filtering criteria for the object usage.

columns.name: EXTRACT_REGISTRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the extract is registered.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the data object usage is active

columns.name: USAGE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the data object usage.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Indicates the unique identifier of the application.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
